data.name: Hardin
data.gender_notes: Hardin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hardin is derived from the Old English words ‘heard’ meaning ‘brave, hardy, strong’ and ‘ing’ meaning ‘son of’. This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxon and Norman people, and was often given to sons to reflect their strength and courage. The name Hardin carries the meaning “Strong, Hardy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hardin usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, hardy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing inner strength and unwavering faith.
data.etymology: Hardin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Hardy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hardin total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
